create_Collision2D_instance: create a Collision2D cost function with a Point2 or SE2 pose and signed distance field parameters
compute_distances_and_jacobians: compute signed distances and jacobians for robot states against a 2D signed distance field
compute_collision_error: compute the collision error by clamping the difference between cost epsilon and signed distances
compute_collision_jacobians: compute jacobians for collision cost function with zeroed values for faraway robot states
update_auxiliary_variable: update an auxiliary variable in the Collision2D cost function and refresh the SDF container data
